name: Lily Salvatana
original_name: リリィ・サルバターナ
source:
A cold-blooded female bounty hunter feared by the nickname "Vulture."

Relentlessly targeting "Black Franco." 

A lesbian dressed in luxurious men's clothing. She has a wide range of expensive and high-performance firearms, and can handle them with ease. Among them, her absolute favourite is the homemade Mauser C96 replica.

[Description based on [url=https://www.nitroplus.co.jp/pc/lineup/into_13/htmlver/chara02.html]the official page[/url]]

Bounty Hunter.
Favoured Gun: [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mauser_C96]Mauser C96[/url]
